factual_claims.claim: Frontier firms in the top 10% of monthly AI usage generate 8.3 times as many output tokens per active user as typical firms, representing a threefold increase from the 2.6-fold gap observed in January.
As of June, Codex generated 64% of combined Codex and ChatGPT output tokens among enterprise customers, indicating a significant shift toward agentic and multi-step execution tasks.
Weekly active enterprise Codex users grew 108% in legal, 41% in sales, 41% in recruiting, and 26% in marketing since February, compared with 5% in software engineering.

Among weekly active users at frontier firms, 21% use Plugins and 19% use skills, compared with 9% and 3% respectively at typical firms, while internal OpenAI usage reaches 95% for weekly Plugin adoption.
Six months after adoption, early-career employees sent 13 more messages per week on average than corporate executives.
